cases.title: Scenario 1: Batasan Hills outage, cause and restoration time

grade.notes: Replies are short, spoken-style and professional, with the right tool lines and goodbye, and she gives both the cause and the restoration time. Minor slips: she said "today at 11:30 PM" when the style says to give only the time, and "Verified na po kayo" is more Tagalog than the set phrases the style allows.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Kidlat Fiber. This is Tala, an AI assistant, and this call is recorded for quality. How can I help you po?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hello po. Wala pong internet sa bahay namin simula kaninang umaga. Gusto ko sanang malaman kung bakit po, tsaka kung kailan babalik.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Sorry to hear that po. May I have your Kidlat Fiber account number and the last four digits of the mobile number registered on the account?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Opo, account number ko po ay 8012345601. Tapos yung last four digits ng mobile number ay 0101.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Thank you po. Sandali lang po, let me verify your account.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Verified na po kayo, Ma'am Maria. Let me check your area for outages now.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: There's an outage in your area po, caused by a fiber cable cut along Batasan Road during road works. Estimated restoration is today at 11:30 PM.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Ay, ganun po ba. Salamat po sa info. So fiber cable cut po sa Batasan Road dahil sa road works, tapos babalik daw po ng 11:30 PM ngayong gabi. Okay na po yun, salamat po. Paalam na po.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: You're welcome po, Ma'am Maria. Thank you for calling Kidlat Fiber.
